entities.name: Adrasteia
entities.description: One of the three spinning Fates of Theros, who cuts the threads of mortals whose lives have finished.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane whose destinies the Fates weave.

entities.name: The Fates
aliases: the three spinning fates of Theros
entities.description: Three sisters who weave and cut the threads of destiny of all in Theros.

entities.name: Agent of the Fates
entities.description: An agent the Fates can call on to solve problems in the weave, whom Adrasteia chose not to trouble.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god who once offered to forge Adrasteia a new set of shears.

events.summary: Adrasteia notices a snarl of two intertwined threads, one blue and one gold, in the weave of the Fates.
events.quote: At one point, Adrasteia noticed a particularly large snarl of threads in the weave of the Fates.

events.summary: Adrasteia decides one thread cannot be saved without harming the other, since their destinies are bound together.
events.quote: One without the other could weaken the tapestry, leaving it prone to irreparable tears.

events.summary: Adrasteia takes out her crooked black shears from a box beneath the table.
events.quote: The shears could never be fully closed.

events.summary: Adrasteia misjudges her snip and cuts off the tip of her thumb, staining the tapestry with a drop of her blood.
events.quote: The shears took the snarl, and along with it the very tip of her thumb.

relations.note: offered to forge her a new set of shears, which she and her sisters mocked
relations.quote: Purphoros had offered to forge her a new set long ago
